# CIS coverage

<!-- Generated by scripts/gen_coverage.py from `tmaegis rules export`. Edit that script, not the tables. -->

16,927 active rules across 96 targets in `rules/`: 12,866 automated audits and 4,061 manual review items. Converted, not-yet-reviewed CIS OS rules live in `rules-staging/` and are not counted.
Regenerate this page with `python3 scripts/gen_coverage.py`.

Columns: **Automated** rules run a read-only audit and report PASS/FAIL; **Manual** rules are reported as SKIP with the
review steps (use `--include-manual` to list them). **Source** is the CIS PDF version in `benchmarks/` that the section
numbers and titles come from (141 benchmark packs); *topic* rows are TMAegis-authored controls that follow a
benchmark's topics and say "verify section number" in their reference.

## Running each kind

```bash
# 1. Host OS + installed software (auto-detected)
tmaegis scan --auto-detect

# 2. Specific OS or server/database target
tmaegis scan --target linux --level 1
tmaegis scan --target postgres

# 3. Cloud account (agentless, uses your local CLI/SDK credentials)
tmaegis scan --target aws
tmaegis apply --target aws --terraform-out ./proposed

# 4. Network device (offline audit of an exported running configuration)
tmaegis scan --target cisco-ios --device-config r1.cfg

# 5. DevSecOps repository supply-chain audit (run inside a Git checkout)
tmaegis scan --target supply-chain

# 6. Manual review checklists (lists manual controls with audit instructions)
tmaegis scan --target ios --include-manual

# 7. Interactive local desktop GUI
tmaegis gui
```

On Windows, rules written for POSIX `sh` (cloud CLIs, databases) run under Git for Windows' `bash` (set `TMAEGIS_BASH` to override); PowerShell rules run on Linux/macOS when `pwsh` is installed.
